summary: Iteration 38: Document Sharing and Password Management Features Testing - All 19 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified: Admin sharing UI on service-reports, daily-reports, timesheets pages with share icons. Admin supervisors page with reset password key icon. Supervisor dashboard with key icon for change password and duplicate button for documents. Supervisor change-password page working.

Admin reset password endpoint (PUT /api/admin/reset-password/{user_id}) working with proper validation (min 6 chars, user exists)
Change password endpoint (PUT /api/auth/change-password) working for both admin and supervisor roles
Frontend sharing UI implemented on service-reports.tsx, daily-reports.tsx, timesheets.tsx with share modal and supervisor checkboxes
Admin supervisors.tsx has reset password modal with key icon button
Supervisor index.tsx has key icon for change password navigation and duplicate button for shared documents
Supervisor change-password.tsx page working with current/new/confirm password fields
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_pwdreset@twasrepair.com supervisor for password reset testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Document sharing and password management features fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs: POST /api/admin/share-document, POST /api/admin/unshare-document, GET /api/admin/document-shares/{type}/{id}, PUT /api/admin/reset-password/{user_id}, PUT /api/auth/change-password. Frontend pages: Admin service-reports, daily-reports, timesheets have share buttons with modal. Admin supervisors has reset password key icon. Supervisor dashboard has key icon for change password and duplicate button for shared docs. Supervisor change-password page working.
